sourceRoles.operation: original immutable OperationSourceCollection frames; hash exact u64LE length followed by all raw octets
sourceRoles.text: original immutable TextReadSource bytes; no String staging
sourceRoles.index: caller-owned PagedList<usize,N>, admitted before allocation and retained on every refusal
sourceRoles.output: caller-owned TextEncodingOutput is entered only after a finite EntityId success receipt; exact small result extent declared before write

domains.child: child NUL parent NUL slot NUL raw_parent_fingerprint NUL ordinal_u32LE
domains.invocation: invocation NUL parent NUL raw_parent_fingerprint then child pairs each NUL original_id NUL raw_fingerprint

ordering: bytewise child identifier ordering, duplicate identifier ties preserve original input ordinal; cancellable heap sort of admitted scalar ordinals

ownership.parent: all retained index/source/output physical pages require actual pre-admitted parent return or bounded physical disposal

refusals: index page initial4096 exceeds caller admission
actual output extent/write refusal poisons recipient after finite hash success
requiredJoins: actual Store dispatch/group policy retained context
invocation sorted indices immutable during hashing
all early exits explicit source/index/output owner retention
credit: no Native/runtime/Store/all-caller credit until genuine missing/Before then actual owning After
borrowBoundary: hashing consumes the supplied control first and returns a finite EntityId (domain plus16ASCIIbytes); the same cumulative control is then supplied to actual PagedText/inline producer, whose closure only calls EntityId.encode_into(output); no simultaneous mutable control alias
